 REINHARDT KRAUSE 
 07:25 AM ET 11/04/2026
 Datadog (DDOG) stock tanked on Wednesday after the enterprise software maker reported third-quarter earnings and revenue that topped Wall Street estimates while December quarter sales guidance fell short of views and signaled flat sequential  growth. New York-based Datadog reported earnings before the market open. Datadog earnings for the September quarter came in at 81 cents per share on an adjusted…
